LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.SectionDiag: Diagnostics (no need to change for normal play)
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.TooSmall: Window too small - please enlarge the mod settings window
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.RowFailed: This row failed to draw (isolated, see log)
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.NeedParentOn: Turn the row above on for this to take effect
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Use.Recording: When off, no new archive events are recorded (existing archives are kept).
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Use.MaxEvents: How many events are kept per colonist; once the cap is reached no new events are recorded (existing entries are never deleted).
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Use.AutoArchi: Low-value archives of the dead are purged after the retention period, keeping saves small.
Health-based silver value; dead archives below it become eligible for archiving.
Days kept after being marked, before actual deletion.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Use.IdleSplit: When workers exceed devices, the surplus goes to joy (idling) instead of standing around.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Detail.IdleSp: Default on. Turn off if you want everyone on duty regardless of capacity.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Use.AutoDetec: Detects the workshop type from the mix of devices inside it, so you do not have to pick per workshop.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Detail.AutoDe: Default on. Mixed device styles may be undecidable - then pick the type manually on the workshop's Settings page (that workshop is then marked as manually chosen).
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Use.ReplayTim: Refreshes timetables once per day to clear leftover wrong cells.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Detail.Replay: Default on. Cost: it overwrites hand-edited timetables; when off, timetables are written only on roster/device changes.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Use.RestPolic: Default rest policy for new workshops (a workshop can still override it).
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Detail.RestPo: Priority: workshop setting > this > def default (fixed per shift). "Rotate daily" flips sleep rhythm and shows a warning below.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Use.Theme: Colour theme for all mod interfaces.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Use.HiddenWor: Colonists hidden from the vanilla Work tab can only be restored here.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Use.PerfProbe: Every 60 seconds, logs measured timings of key entry points for performance comparison.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Detail.PerfPr: Default off, zero overhead when off. Enable only when profiling stutter and you need before/after numbers.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Use.DebugLive: Writes debug counters to the log (debug); nothing is shown on screen.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Use.StartupSe: Runs a self-test on load and reports it (requires dev mode).
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.Settings.Detail.Startu: Default on, shown at most once per session, invisible without dev mode. Fastest way to self-verify when something breaks.
